title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!

About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.

About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.

Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.

Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.

Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).

Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A ContabilizaEcom é uma empresa de contabilidade especialmente voltada para o e‑commerce, que combina expertise fiscal, tributária e empresarial para apoiar lojas online no Brasil.

Alguns destaques da empresa:

  • Foi criada por quem “nasceu em um e‑commerce”, ou seja, compreende os desafios práticos desse tipo de negócio.
  • Oferece serviços como abertura de empresa, análise fiscal de produtos, configuração de ERP e canais de venda, recuperação de impostos pagos indevidamente, planejamento tributário e busca de benefícios fiscais.
  • Foca em economia de impostos, segurança jurídica e regularização fiscal dos seus clientes.
  • Tem métricas que demonstram credibilidade: mais de 300 sellers ativos, cerca de 96% de satisfação dos clientes e mais de R$ 10 milhões em impostos economizados.

Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos procurando um Assistente de Folha de Pagamento (DP) para se juntar à equipe da ContabilizaEcom em Curitiba. Este cargo envolve a execução de tarefas diárias relacionadas a folha de pagamento no setor de departamento pessoal que busque a garantia de conformidade com as leis trabalhistas e legais vigentes.

Este é um cargo de tempo integral presencial, permitindo algumas atividades administrativas realizadas remotamente, onde o colaborador tem espaço para o crescimento em um ambiente descontraído com limites e responsabilidades.

Qualificações acadêmicas esperadas e atribuições da função

  • Formação: Graduação cursando ou completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, RH ou áreas correlatas.
  • Processamento da Folha: Executar o cálculo mensal da folha de pagamento, garantindo a exatidão de salários, descontos e proventos.
  • Cálculo de Encargos: Calcular e conferir o INSS, FGTS e IRRF.
  • Fechamento e Conferência: Realizar o fechamento da folha e emitir os relatórios de conferência (holerites), assegurando a conformidade legal.
  • Emissão de Guias: Gerar e enviar as guias de recolhimento dos encargos sociais e impostos (Ex: DAF, GPS/DARF Previdenciário).
  • Rotinas de Pessoal: executar cálculo e registro de férias e processamento de rescisões contratuais, com o devido registro no sistema.
  • Obrigações Acessórias: Realizar o lançamento e acompanhamento dos eventos mensais e periódicos no eSocial, garantindo a qualidade e o envio das informações.
  • Atendimento: Prestar suporte e esclarecimento de dúvidas aos colaboradores sobre holerites, benefícios e questões trabalhistas básicas.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Organização.
  • Habilidades de análise.
  • Proatividade.

Remuneração:

  • Salário a combinar (enviar pretensão salarial no currículo)
  • Vale transporte

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale transporte
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Plano de carreira
  • Auxílio faculdade

title: Gerente de Obras Civis (Experiência em Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Gerente de Obras Civis, que será responsável pela execução civil de projetos petroquímicos, controlando interfaces, assegurando conformidade técnica, integridade estrutural, execução sequenciada e aderência a requisitos de segurança de processo. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

  • Alinhar bases civis, estruturas, pipe-racks, utilidades e áreas de processo conforme sequenciamento eletromecânico e de instrumentação do projeto;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas multidisciplinares (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I, Automação, SMS) para garantir a compatibilização de projetos e a antecipação de interferências críticas durante a execução das obras;
  • Validar soluções de projeto civil com foco nas necessidades específicas da planta, como cargas dinâmicas de equipamentos rotativos, vibração, fundações especiais para tanques e suportação de tubulações;
  • Controlar interfaces com montagens industriais, garantindo que as estruturas civis, bases e alinhamentos estejam liberados dentro do prazo para instalação de equipamentos críticos;
  • Gerenciar o desenvolvimento e atualização do ‘’As Built” civil sincronizado com alterações de campo, revisões de engenharia e modificações industriais (MOCs);
  • Acompanhar e validar ensaios e controles tecnológicos essenciais para áreas industriais, como ensaio de compactação, ensaios de integridade estrutural, controle de concretagem para bases de equipamentos e pavimentos industriais;
  • Integrar a obra civil aos requisitos de segurança de processo, garantindo atendimento a normas, zoneamentos, distanciamentos, contenções, bacias e drenagem industrial;
  • Gerenciar a interface com fornecedores e contratados, alinhando soluções técnicas e cronogramas para minimizar impactos entre civil, montagem eletromecânica e comissionamento;
  • Atuar em parceria com a área de Suprimentos, dimensionando corretamente a compra de materiais, prezando por custo e boa gestão de estoques;
  • Manter relacionamento produtivo e transparente com entidades sindicais e órgãos fiscalizadores, conhecendo a legislação trabalhista e convenção coletiva, preservando a segurança empresarial.

Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Civil;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência em obras do ramo industrial (plantas químicas, petroquímicas, siderúrgicas ou de processamento de gás, refinarias, termelétricas ou demais correlatas);
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca de metodologias 3D voltadas à modelagem e integração multidisciplinar (Civil, Mecânica, Tubulação, E&I);
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. title: Partner Lead - Creator & IRL Business
description:
The position can be based anywhere in Latin America (Fully Remote).

About TVU Networks

TVU Networks is redefining how live content is created and distributed, from global broadcasters and sports leagues to the fastest-growing creator ecosystem.

As live streaming evolves from studios to the streets, from TV to creators, TVU provides the infrastructure powering reliable live video anywhere, trusted by major media organizations and top streamers worldwide.

The next phase of growth is expanding our creator and IRL ecosystem globally, and LATAM is a key frontier.

Role Overview

We are looking for a strong Partner Lead to build and scale TVU’s content creator ecosystem across Latin America, Spain and Portugal.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role focused on developing partnerships with agencies, creators, production partners, and resellers, while driving revenue growth across hardware, connectivity, and self-served SaaS solutions.

Based in Latin America (fully remote), reporting to the VP of Content Creator Unit, you will act as the local engine of growth, helping partners succeed, unlocking new markets, reducing operational friction, and ensuring creators can adopt TVU seamlessly.

This role sits at the intersection of sales, partnerships, market development, and community building.

What You'll Do

  • Recruit and activate partners (agencies, resellers, production, creator networks)
  • Drive revenue across packs, data, support and mobile apps.
  • Support partners through deals, logistics, and deployments
  • Build relationships with top creators and emerging talent
  • Identify growth opportunities and execute locally
  • Help solve operational and market entry challenges
  • Collaborate with global partner and regional teams

Success Looks Like

  • Strong partner network across key LATAM, Spain & Portugal markets
  • New creator and partner deals closed
  • Growing regional revenue contribution
  • Clear pipeline and local momentum
  • Partners actively selling and advocating for TVU

Who You Are

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on
  • Strong network in media, creators, streaming, or tech
  • Comfortable owning revenue outcomes
  • Fluent Spanish and English (Portuguese a big plus)
  • Thrive in fast, ambiguous environments

Why This Role

  • Remote position anywhere in Latin America with high autonomy
  • Be part of a fast-paced, fast-growing Silicon Valley company with 300+ team members worldwide
  • Work at the center of the rapidly evolving creator economy
  • You’ll help shape how the next generation of live creators operates, with real ownership, global visibility, and direct impact on growth

title: Especialista em Viário (Owner’s Engineer)
description:
Estamos estruturando o time do Consórcio Gerenciador (Owner’s Engineer) para um dos mais relevantes empreendimentos de infraestrutura do país. Trata-se de um projeto portuário de grande porte, com solução de engenharia inovadora e elevada complexidade técnica, envolvendo interface com operações logísticas estratégicas e alto nível de exigência em planejamento, gestão e controle.

Por que essa vaga é diferente?

Você será a referência de Viário no ciclo completo do projeto da concepção e definição de premissas, passando por projeto executivo, até entrega da obra garantindo conformidade contratual e ARTESP, com interface contínua com EPC (projetista + construtora).

Modelo e local de trabalho:

Contratação: PJ (tempo indeterminado)

Reporte: Gerente de Engenharia (interface direta e contínua com EPC)

Regime: presencial, com home office em dias a combinar conforme programação semanal

Base inicial: São Paulo — Parque da Cidade (Av. das Nações Unidas, 14401)

Atividades presenciais em Santos ao longo de 2027 (frequência a confirmar)

Responsabilidades da posição:

Premissas e soluções viárias (do zero até a entrega)

  • Ser o ponto focal técnico de Viário para os acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, garantindo coerência entre premissas, alternativas, projeto executivo e obra.
  • Definir, revisar e validar critérios e padrões de projeto (geometria, velocidades, níveis de serviço, superelevação, seções típicas, drenagem associada e interfaces), considerando restrições urbanas e ambiente portuário.
  • Analisar e apoiar estudos de alternativas (traçados, interseções, dispositivos, acessos, retornos e conexões), incluindo avaliações comparativas de desempenho, construtibilidade, riscos e impactos.

Integrações e interfaces urbanas/operacionais

  • Garantir integração do viário com disciplinas correlatas: estruturas/OAEs, contenções, pavimentação, drenagem, sinalização/segurança viária, iluminação, utilidades/interferências, desapropriações e acessibilidade.
  • Coordenar requisitos para atendimento a condicionantes de tráfego (manutenção de circulação, planos de desvio, fases de obra, acesso a comunidades/operadores e logística do canteiro).
  • Atuar na compatibilização com operação de sistemas associados quando aplicável (fluxos, restrições, acessos operacionais/emergência e áreas técnicas).

Pavimentação e reabilitação viária

  • Revisar e validar soluções de pavimentação (dimensionamento, materiais, camadas, controles tecnológicos, vida útil e estratégias de manutenção), incluindo intervenções em vias existentes, reforços e recomposições.
  • Validar critérios de desempenho e durabilidade compatíveis com tráfego previsto, ambiente e restrições de execução.

Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

  • Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de desenhos, memoriais, especificações, quantitativos, critérios de aceitação e planos de inspeção/ensaio, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação.
  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista e o CQP/certificação, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de projeto, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 5 anos) em projetos viários urbanos e/ou rodoviários, com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica (geometria, dispositivos, acessos e interseções)
  • Vivência com obras complexas e interfaces multidisciplinares (EPC, projetista, construtora, certificação/qualidade).
  • Capacidade de conduzir análises técnicas e propor soluções considerando segurança viária, construtibilidade, impactos urbanos e faseamento de obra.
  • Capacidade de revisão crítica de projetos e comunicação clara entre times de projeto, obra e stakeholders.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório; fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com planejamento e gestão de tráfego em obra (desvios, fases, manutenção de circulação e comunicação com partes interessadas).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de governança técnica, auditoria, rastreabilidade e gestão de interfaces.

O que você ganha trabalhando aqui

Participação em um projeto de grande impacto regional e nacional, com solução de engenharia túnel imerso, pioneiro na América Latina.

Experiência única, com atuação no viário dos acessos urbanos e integrações do empreendimento, em um ambiente portuário de alta complexidade, com participantes internacionais, em um time com tomada de decisão de alto nível.

Processo e remuneração

Valores serão compartilhados com candidatos que avançarem para a próxima etapa.

Na fase seguinte, solicitaremos uma apresentação aos selecionados.

Como se candidatar

Envie CV destacando pontos aderência aos requisitos da vaga.

title: Dealer Development Manager
description:
Job Description

Role Title: Dealer Network Development Manager

Experience Required: 5+ years of relevant experience

Role Purpose

To drive dealer network effectiveness, profitability, and readiness by ensuring process excellence, systems standardization, and continuous capability enhancement across all dealerships.

This role is pivotal in shaping the future of the dealer network by enforcing strong process discipline and enabling sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Dealer Network Development & Performance

  • Drive network planning and coverage expansion to ensure strategic presence across markets and maximize business potential.
  • Design and implement workshops aligned with Corporate Identity (CI) norms to optimize dealer infrastructure and service readiness.
  • Conduct periodic dealer performance reviews to evaluate business health, profitability, and customer experience outcomes.
  • Identify underperforming dealerships, recommend improvement plans, and oversee implementation through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strengthen dealer capability through structured engagement, capability-building, and performance enhancement programs.
  • Partner with field teams to ensure a uniform brand experience across all customer touchpoints, including sales and after-sales.

2. Systems, Processes & Operational Excellence

  • Establish and standardize systems, processes, and review mechanisms across dealerships and regions to ensure consistent operations and governance.
  • Implement and monitor business analytics and intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making and dealership profitability tracking.
  • Lead process improvement and re-engineering initiatives to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and overall dealer–customer experience.
  • Identify and replicate Good Working Practices (GWPs) within the automotive industry to drive continuous improvement.
  • Conduct dealership audits to assess adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and recommend corrective actions to sustain compliance and performance.
  • Ensure organizational and dealer readiness for new or updated systems, digital tools, and operational frameworks.

Key Interfaces

Internal Stakeholders

  • Field Sales Teams
  • Service Teams
  • Finance
  • Legal

External Stakeholders

  • Dealership Owners
  • Dealership Management Teams

Impact & Contribution

  • Directly impacts dealer profitability, customer experience, and overall market performance.
  • Strengthens network capability through standardized processes, operational efficiency, and strategic coverage.
  • Acts as a key enabler in transforming the dealer ecosystem into a digitally capable, performance-driven, and customer-centric network.

title: Managing Director - Crypto Payment
description:
Location: Brazil (must currently reside in Brazil with valid Brazilian ID)

Language: Fluent Portuguese (mandatory), strong English preferred

Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, crypto-savvy Managing Director to lead and expand our crypto payment business in Brazil. The ideal candidate must be Brazil-based, with prior experience in crypto, deep knowledge of the local crypto/payment ecosystem, and strong relationships with key regulatory and industry stakeholders. This role is critical to supporting Brazil licensing efforts, including assisting with the DASP licence, and will work closely with the Brazil AMLO on regulatory matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the company in obtaining the DASP licence, collaborating closely with AMLO Brazil on all regulatory submissions and compliance preparations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with the Brazilian Central Bank (BCB) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) to support licensing and ongoing regulatory engagement.
  • Expand business development opportunities through a strong local network across crypto, payments, fintech, and financial institutions.
  • Lead Brazil's business strategy and drive growth for all crypto-payment products.
  • Maintain excellent relationships with crypto industry associations such as ABCripto, ABCB, and other relevant bodies.
  • Represent the company as the senior business leader in Brazil, attending industry events, regulatory meetings, and partnership discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (product, compliance, legal, operations) to ensure commercial success and regulatory alignment.

Requirements:

  • Must currently reside in Brazil with a valid Brazilian ID.
  • Prior experience in crypto is a must.
  • 10+ years’ experience in crypto payments, payment institutions, fintech, or related financial services.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto/payment regulatory environment, including BCB and CVM frameworks.
  • Proven track record and strong personal network with BCB, CVM, and major industry associations (ABCripto, ABCB).
  • Demonstrated ability to support licensing processes for payment or crypto-related entities in Brazil.
  • Strong business development experience, with a proven ability to grow partnerships and drive commercial expansion.
  • Fluent Portuguese; strong English preferred.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment.

Vision & Mission:

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Diretor(a) de Real Estate, Engenharia e Facilities

Diretor(a) de Real Estate, Engenharia e Facilities

Reporte: CFO – Sodimac Brasil

A Sodimac Brasil, referência no varejo de materiais de construção, busca um(a) Diretor(a) para liderar de forma estratégica e integrada as frentes de Real Estate, Aluguéis, Projetos (reformas e retrofit) e Manutenção/Facilities , garantindo eficiência financeira, sustentabilidade operacional e suporte ao crescimento do negócio.

Esta posição terá papel crítico na otimização do custo de ocupação , na gestão do portfólio imobiliário , na execução de projetos de lojas e na continuidade operacional das unidades , atuando em estreita parceria com Finanças, Operações, Expansão, Jurídico e Compliance.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Estratégia Imobiliária e Gestão de Real Estate

  • Liderar a gestão estratégica dos contratos de locação , incluindo negociações, renovações e revisões contratuais, com foco em redução de custos e captura de valor .
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de sublocação e ocupação alternativa , buscando geração de receitas, redução do custo de ocupação e aumento de fluxo para as lojas.
  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade econômica dos ativos imobiliários, suportando decisões de permanência, renegociação, expansão ou desmobilização.
  • Planejar a ocupação física futura do portfólio considerando mercado, concorrência, tendências do varejo e omnicanalidade.
  • Manter relacionamento institucional sólido com proprietários, administradoras de shoppings, prefeituras, concessionárias e órgãos reguladores .
  • Garantir conformidade legal e regulatória dos imóveis (AVCB, alvarás, licenças, segurança estrutural, normas urbanísticas e sanitárias).
  • Implementar práticas robustas de gestão de riscos estruturais e operacionais .
  • Assegurar a correta gestão e atualização da documentação técnica (laudos, ARTs, certificações e relatórios legais).

2. Gestão de Projetos – Reformas, Ampliações e Retrofit

  • Liderar o pipeline de projetos de lojas , incluindo reformas, ampliações, remodelações e implantação de novos conceitos.
  • Gerir e desenvolver equipes internas e parceiros de arquitetura, engenharia, construção e gerenciamento de obras .
  • Aprovar layouts, projetos executivos, cronogramas e escopos técnicos , assegurando aderência à estratégia da marca.
  • Controlar rigorosamente CAPEX e OPEX dos projetos , garantindo previsibilidade financeira.
  • Acompanhar a execução das obras, assegurando prazo, custo, qualidade e segurança .
  • Implementar e manter padronização arquitetônica e técnica das lojas.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com shoppings, proprietários, prefeituras e órgãos reguladores durante todas as fases dos projetos.

3. Gestão de Manutenção, Facilities e Infraestrutura

  • Assegurar a continuidade operacional das lojas e do CD , garantindo uma experiência segura e positiva para clientes e colaboradores.
  • Estruturar e gerir os processos de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva .
  • Definir SLAs, KPIs e padrões técnicos para equipes internas e fornecedores.
  • Padronizar equipamentos, sistemas e contratos, buscando eficiência operacional e redução de custos .
  • Gerir o relacionamento com as áreas internas clientes (Operações, Comercial, Supply Chain, Segurança, TI).
  • Implementar práticas de melhoria contínua, sustentabilidade e eficiência energética quando aplicável.

4. Orçamento, Governança e Controle Financeiro

  • Responsável integral pelo CAPEX e OPEX da área .
  • Elaborar e gerir o orçamento anual , incluindo:
  • Custos de ocupação (aluguéis, condomínio, IPTU e encargos),
  • Investimentos em reformas e retrofit,
  • Custos de manutenção e facilities.
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos e contratos.
  • Identificar oportunidades contínuas de otimização e redução de custos , mantendo padrões de qualidade, segurança e compliance.
  • Atuar de forma próxima ao CFO, fornecendo análises financeiras, cenários e recomendações estratégicas.

Perfil e Requisitos do(a) Executivo(a)

Formação:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Arquitetura, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão, Finanças, Real Estate ou áreas afins (desejável).

Experiência:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em gestão de Real Estate no varejo , preferencialmente em redes de grande porte.
  • Forte histórico em negociação de contratos de aluguel , gestão de shoppings e proprietários.
  • Experiência robusta em projetos de reforma, retrofit e implantação de lojas .
  • Vivência em gestão de facilities e manutenção de múltiplas unidades .
  • Forte interface com áreas financeiras, reportando para CFO ou Diretoria Executiva.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica aliada à forte capacidade de execução.
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a resultados e controle financeiro.
  • Habilidade de negociação e influência em ambientes complexos.
  • Liderança madura, com capacidade de desenvolver times multidisciplinares.
  • Excelente comunicação e relacionamento institucional.

Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Avenues São Paulo Avenues São Paulo is excited to announce an opportunity for a Data Analyst to join our Admissions, Enrollment, and Finance team. As the owner of our enrollment database (from leads to post-event tracking and campaign performance), you will serve as the key liaison between Finance and Admissions. You will ensure that our data is accurately captured, clearly understood, and effectively reported. After completing enrollment data analyses, you will collaborate with various teams to translate insights into action across the organization.

ABOUT ADMISSIONS & FINANCE AT AVENUES

At Avenues São Paulo, the Admissions and Finance teams work in close partnership to ensure an exceptional experience for families and the long-term sustainability of our school.

The Admissions team is the first point of contact for prospective families, guiding and inspiring them as they learn about our unique global educational offering. With a high-touch, relationship-centered approach, Admissions provides a seamless and caring experience from inquiry to decision, ensuring each school year begins with a fully enrolled community of students who are an excellent match for Avenues and who bring diverse perspectives that enrich our campus.

The Finance team serves as a strategic partner to the school, stewarding resources responsibly to support Avenues’ long-term vision. Through ethical decision-making and comprehensive financial planning, Finance provides reliable, actionable data that informs key decisions, drives continuous improvement, and ensures the financial sustainability of the organization. The team is committed to delivering exceptional service to families and effectively managing the full financial cycle.

Together, Admissions and Finance work collaboratively to support families, strengthen operations, and uphold the mission and sustainability of Avenues São Paulo.

  • You love working with data, gleaning insights from it and helping others to understand it
  • You love collaborating closely with a variety of stakeholders and colleagues, and do so in both English and Portuguese
  • You can juggle multiple, shifting priorities and deliver on challenging deadlines
  • The Avenues mission energizes and inspires you

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. title: Account Executive
description:
About UserGuiding

UserGuiding is a leader in the digital adoption field and has earned a 'Best Software' placement on G2 for two consecutive years. We work with globally recognized companies such as TOTVS, WEG, Caju, Wolters Kluwer, DigitalOcean, and Philip Morris International.

Role Objective

UserGuiding is looking for a results-driven, trilingual Account Executive to spearhead our growth across the Americas. Your primary mission is to lead our expansion in the Brazilian market, while also capturing opportunities in North America and Spanish-speaking LATAM.

You will own the entire revenue pipeline for your region, serving as the primary point of contact for prospects from their first discovery call to their final signature.

Main Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Sales & Closing

  • Execute Inbound/Outbound: Manage inbound leads and signups from Brazil, the US, and LATAM. Perform high-impact discovery calls and tailored product demos.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Lead contract negotiations and overcome objections to convert signups into long-term partners.
  • Cross-Regional Support: While focused on Brazil (Portuguese), you will leverage your time to handle inbound calls and outreach for the US (English) and other LATAM countries (Spanish).

2. Pipeline Generation & Outreach

  • Proactive Prospecting: Engage with high-intent signups and conduct outbound outreach to key decision-makers (Product People and UX Designers).
  • Event Advocacy: Attend and represent UserGuiding at major industry events and meetups in Brazil to build a self-sustaining pipeline.
  • Thought Leadership: Regularly share insights, product updates, and industry trends to build a personal brand that attracts inbound interest on LinkedIn.

3. Strategy & CRM Excellence

  • Market Insights: Feed local market trends and customer needs back to our Product and Marketing teams to help refine our messaging in the region.
  • Hubspot Management: Maintain 100% CRM accuracy, ensuring all deals are properly forecasted and followed up on.

Candidate Profile & Experience

  • Experience: 2–4 years of experience in a sales-centric role, with at least 1 year specifically as an Account Executive within a B2B SaaS startup.

Linguistic Versatility:

  • Portuguese: Native-level (Primary market focus).
  • English: Professional fluency (Internal coordination & North American deals).
  • Spanish: High proficiency (Managing Spanish-speaking LATAM territories).
  • Skills: Strong consultative selling skills, public speaking confidence, and the ability to navigate a "no-code" technical environment. We don’t want someone to show our playground in the first minute. Our sales calls should be in the interview format.

Tech Stack

  • Sales: Hubspot CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo.io
  • Comm: Google Meet, Slack.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: Competitive fixed monthly salary.
  • Variable Bonus: Uncapped quarterly bonuses based on New Business Revenue (NBR) and pipeline targets.
  • Impact: A high-autonomy role where you directly influence UserGuiding's global expansion strategy.

title: Backfill Support Engineer
description:
Title: IT Support (Backfill)

Contract: Long Term

Location: Ibirubá, Brazil United States

Scope of Work

This is a Backfill IT Support (Deskside Support) position for one of our clients in Jundiai, Brazil

The selected candidate will provide on-site technical support covering IT infrastructure, networking, data center operations, and hardware troubleshooting. You will work closely with internal teams, customer teams, and remote technical specialists to identify and resolve issues efficiently. Responsibilities include monitoring system health, supporting network devices, troubleshooting VOIP phones, managing basic server tasks, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT operations following SLA guidelines.

Who We Are – Teceze

Teceze is a global IT solutions and managed services provider, delivering end-to-end support across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. We specialize in providing reliable, secure, and scalable IT services that empower organizations to operate seamlessly. By joining Teceze, you become part of a highly collaborative and technically strong team focused on excellence, innovation, and customer success.

This role is being offered as a backfill position for one of our key clients, ensuring continuity of operations and maintaining service quality on-site.

Job Description:

Basic Knowledge of Network Devices such as Switches, Routers, Wireless Access Points preferably CISCO, Riverbed

• Basics knowledge / understanding of assigning switch ports to specific VLANs

• Patch phone ports to switch as needed

• Basic troubleshooting of Avaya VOIP phones (knowledge on basic configuration)

• Troubleshoot issues with fiber links between switches – Able to visualize errors and communicate to remote technical teams

• Troubleshoot and replace network switch chassis blades when required

• Good to have understanding of any Data Center Infrastructure Management Application

• A periodic (minimum twice weekly) visual check of the IDF rooms for cooling and power status (specifically UPS alarms and PDU health) Control-M, EMC Avamar, Data Domain

• Basic Knowledge of Monitoring tools such as Solarwinds, etc…

• Networking and Operating System basics

• Assist network and data center admins (Internal, Customer and Vendor) as required during the course of technical troubleshooting

• Basic knowledge about Hardware like Servers, Storage devices

• Knowledge to understand Monitoring Tool outcome

• Basic knowledge of ITSM tool preferably ServiceNow

• Basic knowledge Backup technologies preferably EMC Avamar

• Basic knowledge of Operating Systems- Windows 2003 servers Enterprise/Standard Edition, UNIX & linux

• Basic knowledge about Windows 2003 Active Directory structure, MS Exchange 2003 and File/Print Server

• Experience in SLA base environment

• Knowledge on Server Performance monitoring preferred

• Candidate should have minimum 3-5 years' experience in above mentioned area give me the scope of the job and who we are and how to apply

title: Software Developer
description:
The Company:

Hexagon is a global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. We are putting data to work to boost efficiency, productivity, quality, and safety across industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, public sector, and mobility applications.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous — ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

Hexagon’s Mining division solves surface and underground mine challenges with proven technologies for planning, operations, and safety.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,000 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.5bn USD. Learn more at hexagon.com and follow us @HexagonAB.

Purpose of Position:

Hexagon Mining develops intelligent collision avoidance systems for large vehicles used mainly in open-pit mining. Its products integrate satellite navigation, digital radio, multiple sensors and actuation systems as well as sophisticated algorithms to reliably predict dangerous scenarios and prevent accidents. It employs approx. 100 R&D staff in several attractive international locations. The software developer will join the team to develop this solution.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

  • Design, develop and support our server backend services and client tools used for the current and next generation of our collision avoidance and safety system.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware, firmware, and backend service development teams to realize new integrated solutions.
  • Assist the product-introduction team and gain first-hand experience with our products.
  • Bring in innovative ideas for further development.

Knowledge and Experience - Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent;
  • Experience in C and C++ on embedded or Linux systems;
  • MQTT and other IoT related protocols, networking technologies in general, and related network security aspects;
  • Full professional English proficiency;
  • Team oriented and able to work independently;
  • Positive working attitude and good common sense to understand business requirements;
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally;

Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

  • Web technologies, React.js.
  • Knowledge of OpenWRT and Yocto
  • Knowledge of additional high-level language, e.g., Python, C#.
  • Development and/or maintenance of software for safety-critical, automotive, real-time or control systems
  • Development of localization, navigation, or perception systems based on technologies such as GNSS, radio, UWB, automotive radars, and IMUs.
  • Implementation of CAN, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232 or SPI-based drivers.
  • Functional Safety.
  • Experience with Test-Driven Design, Continuous Integration, and agile development processes (e.g., Scrum).

Travel:

  • 5-10%

Benefits:

  • Health plan
  • Comprehensive health program (psychological, nutritional, legal, financial, and social assistance)
  • Wellhub (Gym)
  • Life insurance
  • Meal/food allowance
  • Dental plan
  • Private pension plan

You will work on products that could revolutionize the mining industry in the next 5 years. Your colleagues consist of highly qualified and open-minded engineers from all over the world. Beside the developer career you will have the opportunity to develop into multiple directions like project management, product management, customer support and sales.

Join our team as a software developer and make a significant impact on our clients' digital transformation initiatives. We offer a stimulating work environment, competitive compensation package, and opportunities for professional growth. Apply now and help shape the future of Hexagon’s technology solutions.

Hexagon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against any job applicant based on protected characteristics.

title: Innovation Procurement Coordinator
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

Join Coty and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to shaping the future of the beauty industry in Latin America through a unique footprint. Apply now to contribute your expertise and passion for technology and to drive digital transformation into our business success!

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Innovation Procurement Coordinator, you will be responsible for leading sourcing activities for NPD (New Product Development) initiatives across LATAM, ensuring cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and operational readiness for product launches.

You will act as the procurement focal point within cross-functional innovation teams, managing end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, risk mitigation, and alignment with global and regional category strategies.

This role requires strong project management capabilities, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with R&D, Marketing, Initiative Management, Planning, and Manufacturing to understand upcoming innovation pipelines (2–3 year horizon) and translate them into sourcing strategies, material requirements, and execution roadmaps.
  • Lead end-to-end procurement activities for new peoduct development projects, from brief validation and supplier scouting to commercial negotiation, supplier nomination, and production handover.
  • Manage RFQs, cost breakdown analysis, supplier benchmarking, and negotiations aligned with Category Procurement strategy and financial targets.
  • Drive Design-to-Cost discussions with cross-functional teams, challenging specifications and proposing alternative materials, technical optimizations, and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Anticipate and mitigate supply risks, including tooling constraints, MOQ impacts, lead-time limitations, and supplier capacity risks.
  • Ensure pricing transparency, accurate forecasting inputs, and risk reporting prior to decision gates and launch approvals.
  • Track and report project savings, cost avoidance initiatives, and adherence to target cost objectives.
  • Act as escalation point for project-related supply disruptions until successful start of production (SOP).
  • Coordinate seamless transition from project phase to operational procurement and supply chain teams.
  • Influence stakeholders at managerial level, supporting data-driven decision-making and balancing commercial, technical, and timeline constraints.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, or Supply Chain, preferably within FMCG, beauty, pharma, or consumer goods industries.
  • Proven experience managing sourcing projects linked to product launches or innovation pipelines.
  • Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated cost management results.
  • Solid understanding of cost structures, supplier economics, and total cost of ownership (TCO).
  • Advanced project management capabilities (PMO knowledge required).
  • Advanced Excel skills (cost modeling, scenario analysis); strong PowerPoint storytelling skills.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, or SRM systems is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English required; Spanish is a plus.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Sr. Recruiter
description:
About the job

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

Requirements :

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*

Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Finance Business Partner | Accounts Receivable
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce solutions and technology services provider delivering innovative, results-driven solutions to global enterprises. With deep expertise in financial operations, staffing models, and program management, we help organizations optimize performance while maintaining strong compliance and operational excellence. Our finance team plays a critical role in supporting scalable growth, operational efficiency, and exceptional client experiences across diverse programs.

Summary

The Finance Business Partner will lead Pinnacle Group’s Accounts Receivable operations while serving as a strategic advisor to client-facing business teams. This role is approximately 70% operational, overseeing billing, collections, reconciliations, supplier payments, and team performance, and 30% focused on financial partnership and business support. The ideal candidate will bring strong leadership, analytical expertise, and a client-service mindset to improve AR performance and drive financial excellence. This position is instrumental in ensuring accurate cash flow management, client satisfaction, and continuous process improvement.

Job Description

Accounts Receivable Management

  • Oversee the full AR lifecycle including invoicing, collections, reconciliations, dispute resolution, and aging analysis.
  • Ensure accurate and timely billing while resolving client exceptions efficiently.
  • Monitor client payments, oversee cash application, and ensure timely settlement reconciliation to support 100% on-time supplier payment SLAs.
  • Partner with Accounts Payable and Treasury to align receivables with cash flow forecasts and payment schedules.
  • Monitor receivables aging and collaborate with client stakeholders and PMO teams to resolve payment inquiries.
  • Manage quarterly client and supplier volume rebates with precision and compliance.
  • Standardize AR policies, procedures, and playbooks across programs while maintaining audit readiness and strong internal controls.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance AR efficiency and scalability.

Finance Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance liaison to program leaders and account managers, supporting invoice-related issue resolution.
  • Provide actionable insights on billing behaviors, dispute trends, and invoicing challenges to improve program performance.
  • Present tailored AR reporting to leadership, highlighting risks, opportunities, and business impact.
  • Support onboarding of new client programs with structured billing guidance and financial playbooks.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Contracts to align billing terms and resolve disputes effectively.
  • Handle sensitive financial matters with discretion, urgency, and professionalism.

Team Management & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2–4 AR analysts across onshore and offshore locations.
  • Manage hiring, training, workload distribution, and performance management in coordination with leadership.
  • Track and analyze AR KPIs including on-time billing, payment application, supplier payment SLAs, and resolution timelines.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Design and implement development plans to enhance team autonomy and operational excellence.

Technology & Systems

  • Manage AR modules within Workday and collaborate on system enhancements and integrations.
  • Review testing outcomes for system updates and approve AR-related production releases.
  • Contribute to the AR technology roadmap to support automation and process optimization initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of management experience in Accounts Receivable or related financial operations.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data analysis.
  • Experience with Workday or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Experience in the staffing industry or Pay-When-Paid programs preferred.
  • Proven leadership experience managing diverse teams and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate financial data into business insights.

Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will play a strategic role in shaping financial operations that directly impact business growth and client success. We foster a collaborative, high-performance culture where innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement are valued. This role offers significant visibility across business leadership, opportunities to influence process transformation, and the ability to build and develop a strong finance team. If you are driven by operational excellence and strategic impact, Pinnacle Group offers a platform to grow your leadership career.

title: Gerente Operação de Mina

Desde 1979, quando iniciou suas atividades na unidade Caraíba , a empresa vem consolidando sua presença no setor mineral brasileiro, expandindo para a mina de ouro em Xavantina , avançando na implantação da unidade Tucumã — que promete se tornar um dos principais polos de produção de cobre do país. Nosso crescimento é movido pela experiência em exploração, que nos ajuda a expandir a vida útil de nossas minas e a avançar em novos projetos, como o Projeto Furnas , no Pará.

Nosso jeito de fazer mineração é guiado por valores sólidos: cuidado, coragem, honestidade, colaboração e excelência . Esses princípios estão no centro de tudo o que fazemos — desde o chão da mina até as decisões estratégicas. E eles também orientam como cuidamos do crescimento de cada pessoa na ERO .

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. ● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers

Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)

Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io

Mentalidade e Comportamentos

DIFERENCIAL:

Assistência Médica

title: ESPECIALISTA DE REMUNERAÇÃO (FOCO EM POWERBI)
description:

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Atuar como referência técnica (key-user) dos sistemas de remuneração e estrutura organizacional, apoiando a implantação de novas soluções, melhorias sistêmicas e integrações com outras plataformas de RH;

title: Plant Manager
description:
We are seeking a dynamic Plant Manager to lead our manufacturing operations in Bahía . What You’ll Do

  • Shape the future of manufacturing by developing and executing strategic plans that boost efficiency, productivity, and overall performance.

  • Expertise in lean manufacturing, operational excellence (OPEX), and process optimization.
  • Experience leading operations in Brazil, with deep knowledge of regulatory and safety standards.
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Exceptional communication, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems, manufacturing software, and Microsoft Office.

This is more than a management role—it’s an opportunity to leave your mark on a growing operation . You’ll be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the long-term strategy of the site, and building a high-performing team that thrives on challenge and collaboration. If you’re passionate about driving results, empowering people, and transforming manufacturing, this is your chance to lead with purpose.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
* OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

I MPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
